query_text: how much % do mutual fund managers make

messages.content: how much % do mutual fund managers make

message.content:
Mutual fund managers are usually paid a **salary plus bonus**, not a percentage of the fund’s assets like hedge fund managers.[2][5] Public salary guides in the results show averages around **£43,352 per year** in the UK and about **$81,760 per year** for fund managers more broadly, though pay varies by location, experience, firm size, and performance bonuses.[2][5]

If you mean **“what percentage of the fund do they take?”**, that is generally **not how mutual fund managers are compensated**; that “2 and 20” model applies to hedge funds, where managers may receive a **2% management fee** and **20% performance fee**.[1][3][4]

If you want, I can also give you the typical pay range for **U.S. mutual fund managers specifically**.
